title: Exterior surfaces
prompt: Walk the perimeter and look for cracks, damage, or unusual wear.

title: Entry & access
prompt: Check that doors, locks, steps, and access paths are secure and clear.

title: Interior condition
prompt: Inspect walls, ceilings, floors, and visible signs of moisture.

title: Systems & utilities
prompt: Note the visible condition of electrical, plumbing, heating, and ventilation.

title: Safety & closeout
prompt: Confirm safety equipment is present and record anything needing follow-up.
